name: 埃蒙
src: 月银纪史诗/第三歌_鸦栖之石.md:218
who: Emon, a human boy of seventeen, a youth of the red hall of the far north: about 170 cm, a lean, wiry frame like a tightly wound bowstring, a narrow-waisted, supple silhouette that looks bigger in motion. Wild three-coloured hair: black at the roots, dark red through the middle, gold at the tips, tied back in a messy tail like a half-burnt fire. Winter-lake-ice grey-green eyes, clear and bright. A strikingly pretty, almost delicate face with a pointed chin and thick wild eyebrows. A ring of old bite scars round his left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us). He wears the pelt of an ice-maned wolf on his shoulder, worn bald in patches, and will not replace it. Proud, quick, stubborn, a little feral. No glasses, no earrings, no jewellery. Only his left forearm carries the ring of old bite scars (the arm on the viewer's right when he faces us); his right forearm (viewer's left) is smooth and unmarked, in every panel.
palette: wolf-pelt frost grey, old red wool, ember gold and dark red hair, ice grey-green, black spear shaft
casual: The red hall youths' uniform: a worn short red wool tunic belted with a wide leather belt whose buckle is a single wolf tooth, dark leggings and soft deerskin boots; over his shoulders the pelt of an ice-maned wolf, its head resting on his shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us), the fur worn bald in places. A bright, steady look, the mouth closed. The ring of bite scars shows on the bare left forearm only, the forearm on the viewer's right when he faces us; the forearm on the viewer's left is unmarked.
private: Off duty at the hall: a plain long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and old brown trousers, the wolf pelt folded over one arm, deerskin boots. He holds a wooden cup in both hands; a relaxed, calm look, the mouth closed.
battle: Ready to fight on the ice: the red tunic belted tight, leather bracers over the sleeves, the wolf pelt settled on both shoulders with the head on his shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us), deerskin boots. He grips a long barbed spear with a black shaft and a head ground from the spine bone of a tide-scale serpent, so cold it gives off white vapour, held forward in both hands. A fierce, focused look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and fierce, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the body turned a little sideways, both hands on the barbed black spear held forward; a focused look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the hall's feast: his best clean red wool tunic cut straight and closed at the neck with a single bone toggle, a black leather belt with the wolf-tooth buckle, the ice-maned wolf pelt brushed and worn over both shoulders and pinned with a bone pin, its head resting on his shoulder with frost glittering faintly along the fur. He stands straight with one hand on the shaft of a plain long spear; a proud, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the grey-green eyes wide open and looking at the viewer with a clear, proud, direct look, the mouth closed. Cold blue-white snow light from one side, a warm ember glow from the other lighting the red and gold of his hair. Foreground blur: drifting snow and sparks. He wears the bald-patched wolf pelt with the wolf head on his shoulder.

name: 茉恩
src: 月银纪史诗/第三歌_鸦栖之石.md:274
who: Moen, a human girl of seventeen, the blacksmith's only daughter of the far north: small, about 158 cm, a compact, sturdy, petite frame, fully covered by her clothes. Copper-red short hair cut ragged with tin snips, with one thin braid at the temple ending in a tiny iron ring. Amber eyes like the last coals in a furnace, a spark seems to jump when she blinks. A light scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks, a smear of furnace ash on her left cheek (on the viewer's right when they face us) that she does not know about. Small, hard hands with old burn scars on the knuckles. Around her neck a single wolf tooth on a cord. Fierce, practical, quick-tempered, warm underneath.
palette: copper red and furnace amber, soot black, sheepskin cream, iron grey
casual: Her smithy gear: a sheepskin jacket with the sleeves rolled to the elbow over a long-sleeved wool shirt and trousers, a heavy leather apron burnt through with a few holes, its pocket holding a steel chisel and a small jar of bear grease; boots studded with iron hobnails; the wolf tooth on a cord at her neck. A bright, earnest look, the mouth closed.
private: At home by the forge at night: a long-sleeved, high-necked wool dress to the shins in dusty brown with a soot-stained apron over it, thick knitted stockings and soft shoes, the short hair pushed behind the ears. She holds a mug of broth in both hands; a contented closed-mouth smile.
battle: Standing guard at the forge door: the burnt leather apron cinched tight, leather gloves, the sheepskin jacket buttoned, hobnailed boots. She grips a heavy long-handled pair of iron tongs in her right hand held out like a weapon, an iron-bound mallet hanging in her left; a determined look, the brows drawn together, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and fierce, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the brows drawn together and the mouth closed, gripping the heavy iron tongs forward in one hand and the mallet low in the other; she is not smiling in this one.
formal: At the hall's midwinter feast: a straight-cut long gown of red-dyed wool like the hall's youth tunics, long sleeves gathered at the cuffs with leather thongs, a wide leather belt, no collar at all, the wolf tooth on its cord worn outside it and a small iron ring pinned at the shoulder with a faint ember-orange line glowing in it. The apron is left off. She stands straight with hands folded in front; a shy, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the amber eyes looking at the viewer with a bright, straight, slightly defiant look, the mouth closed. Warm orange forge glow from one side, cold blue snow light from the other. Foreground blur: flying sparks and a hanging iron chain. She wears the sheepskin jacket with the wolf tooth at her neck.

name: 菲尔迪
src: 月银纪史诗/第三歌_鸦栖之石.md:331
who: Fildi, a human warrior of nineteen, a fighter of the red hall: about 191 cm, a huge broad-shouldered, thick-backed man who has to turn sideways through doorways, arms thicker than most men's legs, but a young man's open face. Wheat-gold long hair in two war braids hanging over his chest with red cords woven in. Clear sunny-sky blue eyes that look at people with a smile. A broad, kind, well-formed face, a thin pale scar through his right eyebrow splitting it in two (on the viewer's left when they face us). Both forearms have a faint sheen like polished horn, and blades leave only a white line. Cheerful, generous, an easy drinking-companion air. The thin pale scar through his right eyebrow (on the viewer's left when he faces us) must be clearly drawn in every panel and every expression face: that eyebrow is visibly cut into two pieces by a narrow hairless pale gap; the other eyebrow is whole.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, kind young man's face of nineteen, NOT angular: clear sky-blue slightly slanted eyes with a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line; wheat-gold eyebrows, the right one cut by a thin pale scar (on the viewer's left when they face us); a straight nose; a wide, easy smile with ordinary teeth. Clean skin, soft warm shadows.
build: 191 cm, huge and broad: very wide shoulders, a thick chest and back, arms thicker than most men's legs, solid legs.
palette: wheat gold and sunny blue, bearskin brown, iron grey, red cord
casual: His warrior's dress: a heavy bearskin cloak thrown over one shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us) over a shirt of overlapping iron scales that the blacksmith made, leather trousers and boots; a wide belt with a short wide-bladed sword at the hip; the two war braids with red cords hanging over his chest. A big warm grin.
private: Off duty in the long hall: a loose undyed wool shirt with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up, the braids loose, plain brown trousers and soft boots. He holds a big horn cup in one hand; a lazy, friendly grin.
battle: Ready to hold the line: the iron-scale shirt belted tight, the bearskin cloak thrown back over the shoulder, leather bracers. He carries a round shield bound with iron and painted with a single red branch on his left arm (on the viewer's right when they face us) and a short spear in his right hand held ready. A fierce, steady look, the jaw set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and immovable, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the round red-branch shield held up at the left arm and the short spear held ready in the right hand; a fierce, steady look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the hall's feast: the iron-scale shirt polished under a clean red wool surcoat, the bearskin cloak brushed and pinned at one shoulder with a bronze clasp, the braids freshly tied with new red cords. He stands tall with the hands clasped in front; a proud, glad smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the sunny blue eyes looking at the viewer with a big, warm, open look, a wide smile. Low golden light from one side, cold blue snow light from the other. Foreground blur: a raised horn cup and falling snow. He wears the bearskin cloak over the iron-scale shirt, the two braids on his chest.

name: 孔恩
src: 月银纪史诗/第三歌_鸦栖之石.md:570
who: Kong, a human king of the far north in his fifties, a careful and timid ruler: about 175 cm, a middling, slightly stooped, narrow-shouldered build. Neatly trimmed red beard and short red hair going thin, a tired, calculating, soft face, pale blue-grey eyes that avoid looking directly. On his head a plain iron-banded crown set with a small orange-ice beast core, the core of a wolf-pack leader he killed in his youth, which he touches often. Careful, anxious, honest in his sums.
face: FACE, as in the references: a careful man's face of fifty-odd, NOT young: tired pale blue-grey eyes with fine lines at their corners, thin red eyebrows, a straight nose, a neat red beard, a thin worried closed mouth; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 175 cm, middling build, slightly stooped, narrow shoulders and a soft middle.
palette: beard red and orange-ice, heavy blue-grey wool, fur white, iron grey
casual: His king's everyday dress: a heavy blue-grey wool robe lined with white wolf fur, belted at the waist with a plain leather belt, dark trousers and fur boots; the iron-banded crown with the small orange-ice core on his head, one hand raised to touch it. A worried, tired look.
private: Quiet at night: a plain long undyed wool tunic with long sleeves, a thick grey cloak over his shoulders, soft fur-lined shoes, the crown off and held in one hand; a tired, mild look.
battle: He does not fight: dressed for the cold of the great sacrifice, the fur-lined robe belted tight under a heavy hooded cloak, fur gloves, fur boots, the crown on his head. He holds a plain wooden staff of office in one hand, the other hand pressed to his chest; an anxious but resolved look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit for the sacrifice: braced and resolved, the shoulders drawn in, the feet planted, one hand on a plain wooden staff of office and the other hand pressed flat to the chest; an anxious but set expression, the mouth closed.
formal: In the long hall: a heavy king's robe of pale frost-tusk hide worn fur outward over his shoulders, a wide white fox-fur collar kept at the throat, a string of beast teeth hanging across the chest instead of any chain, and a plain blue-grey wool tunic with a wide leather belt beneath. The crown with the small orange-ice core is set straight, and a cold mist drifts off the fur. He stands upright with hands folded; a careful, dignified look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the pale blue-grey eyes looking at the viewer with a tired, careful, honest look, the mouth closed. Cold blue snow light from one side, the orange glow of the crown's core on the other. Foreground blur: falling snow and frost. He wears the white-furred robe and the crown with the small core.

name: 库林
src: 月银纪史诗/第三歌_鸦栖之石.md:584
who: Kurin, a human blacksmith of the far north, the best smith of the red hall: short and stocky, about 160 cm, wide and thick-armed, a barrel chest. Bald, with a thick beard half burnt away by sparks, a ruddy broad face, small warm dark eyes. Both forearms freckled with old spark burns. Loud, soft-hearted, sentimental, given to tears after a drink.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, ruddy man's face of fifty-odd, NOT young: small warm dark eyes with laugh lines at their corners, bushy eyebrows, a thick flat nose, a thick beard singed short on one side, a wide soft mouth; skin shadows a warm red-orange.
build: 160 cm, short and stocky: a barrel chest, thick forearms, thick legs.
palette: forge orange and soot black, leather brown, beard grey-brown, iron grey
casual: His smith's clothes: a thick leather apron burnt through in places over a rolled-sleeve wool shirt and trousers, heavy boots; a hammer in his right hand and a pair of tongs in his belt. A loud, warm grin.
private: At home: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, no apron, soft old shoes, a mug in one hand and a rag in the other; a soft, damp-eyed smile.
battle: He does not fight: braced at the anvil, the leather apron cinched, thick gloves, a leather cap. He grips the big forging hammer in both hands held across his body; a stubborn look, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the forge outfit: braced and stubborn, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, gripping a big forging hammer in both hands across the body; a stubborn look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the hall's feast: a clean dark wool jerkin over a white shirt, a fur-trimmed cloak pinned with a plain iron clasp, the beard combed, a small hammer-shaped pin at the chest. He stands upright with the hands behind the back; a shy, proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the small dark eyes looking at the viewer with a warm, moist, open look, a small smile. Orange forge light from one side, cold snow light from the other. Foreground blur: flying sparks and a glowing spearhead. He wears the burnt leather apron.

name: 卡斯巴
src: 月银纪史诗/第三歌_鸦栖之石.md:598
who: Kasba, a human priest of the red hall of the far north, very old: about 172 cm, thin and gaunt, a little stooped. A long white beard hanging to his waist, white hair under a hood. His right eye is blind and milky white (on the viewer's left when they face us), the other eye a sharp pale blue that watches the sky. A deeply lined, stern face. Speaks like a riddle and never explains. Carries a plain wooden staff hung with a few small bone charms.
face: FACE, as in the references: a deeply lined old man's face of eighty, NOT young: one milky blind eye (on the viewer's left when they face us) and one sharp pale blue eye, heavy white eyebrows, a thin hooked nose, a long white beard, a thin closed mouth; skin shadows a cool pale grey.
build: 172 cm, thin and gaunt, a little stooped.
palette: snow white and bone, deep sky blue, charcoal grey wool, silver
casual: His priest's robe: a long charcoal-grey wool robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a heavy fur-edged grey mantle over it, fur boots; a plain wooden staff in his right hand hung with small bone charms. A stern, distant look.
private: At rest: a long undyed wool robe with a blanket-cloak over the shoulders, soft shoes, the staff leaned against his arm. He holds a small bowl of broth in both hands; a quiet, far-off look.
battle: He does not fight: dressed for the cold watch on the south bank, the grey robe belted tight under a heavy hooded mantle, fur gloves, fur boots. He holds the bone-charm staff in his right hand, the left hand pointing at the sky; a stern, certain look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the watch outfit: upright and stern, the feet planted, one hand holding the bone-charm staff and the other hand pointing up at the sky; a certain, set expression, the mouth closed.
formal: In the long hall: a clean white wool robe with a silver-grey border at the hem and cuffs, a pale grey mantle pinned with a bone clasp, the beard combed and the hair brushed back. He stands upright with the staff held in front; a grave, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the sharp pale blue eye looking at the viewer with a long, stern, weighing look, the blind white eye beside it, the mouth closed. Cold pale blue sky light from one side, a faint ember glow on the other. Foreground blur: falling snow. He wears the grey fur-edged mantle with the bone charms by his cheek.
